entities.summary: Allan Gerald "Mouse" Pinder is a Canadian former professional ice hockey player who played 353 games in the World Hockey Association and 223 games in the National Hockey League. He played for the Chicago Black Hawks, California Golden Seals, San Diego Mariners, Cleveland Crusaders, and Edmonton Oilers. He also played for Canada at the 1968 Winter Olympics, winning bronze, and at the 1969 World Championships.
